title: Rollout inspection: redlines, QA handoff, and visual polish pass for console rollout & cost cards
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Purpose: finalize visual redlines and QA criteria for the new rollout cards and compact cost view before engineering handoff. Goals: 1) capture stakeholder redlines from the Feb 9 design review; 2) produce a QA checklist and pixel/spacing redlines; 3) record accessibility/contrast decisions; 4) outline acceptance criteria for the launch slot in console-2026.03.

Scope: visual polish and review cycles for three related areas: rollout list item (canary/cutover indicator states), rollout detail modal (metrics and fallback controls), and compact cost cards used on the project overview dashboard. This ticket tracks design-side review, signoffs, and artifacts handoff to ENG and PM.

Deliverables: final Figma frames with redlines, accessible color token table, exportable spec PDF, annotated QA checklist, and a small dev-ready token diff that calls out spacing and typography changes.

Acceptance criteria: 1) All stakeholder comments from Feb 9 review addressed or linked to follow-ups. 2) Redlines annotated in Figma and exported as spec PDF. 3) QA checklist created and agreed by QA lead. 4) ENG-1987 (rollout backend flags) is not blocked by design decisions. 5) PM signoff recorded in Confluence.

Notes: we opted to keep the compact cost card density for dedicated customers but added a hover-expander to show burst pricing; this was a product request (PM-522). A11y pass requires contrast tweaks to the muted token and focused keyboard state; ENG implementation will need a small CSS utility update (see ENG-2089).
comments: 2026-02-09 - Jonas Meyer (PM): Good progress in the prototype. Two asks: (1) show explicit fallback state when a model variant is unavailable, (2) include per-route cost preview on hover. Marked as high priority for Dedicated customers.

2026-02-10 - Aisha Patel (Designer): Uploaded iteration 3 with hover-expander and updated iconography. Filed redline notes in Figma. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/console-rollouts-cost-cards--polish

2026-02-12 - Leila Ortiz (QA): Early QA pass: spacing between metric rows inconsistent in small breakpoint; keyboard focus order on rollout modal not preserved. Added checklist items. See Drive QA doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1XyZ-design-assets-rollouts-polish

2026-02-15 - Maya Chen (Design Lead): Decision: keep visual weight of primary action (Promote rollout) and reduce prominence of secondary link; updated tokens and requested ENG implement focus ring per a11y spec. Assigned ENG-2089 for CSS utility change.
2026-02-16 - Priya Nair (Accessibility): Contrast test pass except muted subtext on cost card at 12px; recommend 13px or stronger token. Marked as a must-fix before integration testing.

2026-02-18 - Nick Huang (Engineering reviewer): Reviewed redlines. Technical concerns: hover-expander needs debounce to avoid reflows with streaming metrics; recommend ENG-2120 as follow-up if latency appears. Otherwise OK to handoff once QA checklist items cleared.

2026-02-20 - Aisha Patel (Designer): Uploaded spec PDF and annotated tokens export; requested final PM signoff. Confluence page updated: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CON/Console+Rollout+Design+Spec
